attack: a receipt inside the layer the report names is edited after the report was written
why: the layer must be re-read and the changed file NAMED; otherwise 'the digest matches' answers a different question
wouldBeWrongIf: READY, or a refusal that only says the digest differs without naming the changed scenario

expects.expectMessagePattern: changed after the report was written

allowedSecondary.AUDIT_ID_MISMATCH: the id is derived from the corpus id, which cannot match a tampered layer
